pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries. Geometric shapes exhibit high angularity on the upper neck and flank, transitioning to slightly more rounded edges towards the posterior flank. Spatial area of dark patches is high relative to the inter-patch distance.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected web of light-colored negative space forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes consist primarily of tri-radiate and tetra-radiate intersections. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively thin and uniform across the neck and dorsal region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dark, bristly mane along the superior margin of the neck displaying a high-frequency, jagged 1D silhouette with varied amplitude against the lighter background.
